title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Solo #23 (SpanishAndalusian+FinnishIittala)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Jamaican woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, sultry, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her LEFT side is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her RIGHT side is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following every crease, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Footwear: extreme platform stiletto ankle boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
